title: GF2 VR Install & Manage
toolsScope: This package installs the settings program only. The existing VR mod stays unchanged.
noRuntimeRelease: A distributable VR runtime package is not ready yet. Select a local package to inspect its contents.
notInstalled: No installation receipt from this tool. Nothing is removed by guess.
policy:
Close the game first. Settings, logs and other mods are preserved. Start the game and SteamVR manually.
Remove restores the previous version when present; otherwise it removes recorded owned files. Use Recover after interruption.
Automatic download/update and actual game/VR validation are pending. Local hashes check file integrity.
